Name: 夏娃
Desc: 世人相信她是全世界第一個女人，傳說中為了活下去，她可以自由改變皮膚顏色。
_enDesc: Nobody knows how she got onto Bermuda, except that she was here before everyone else. Extremely good at adapting to the environment, she is like a chameleon that survives and thrives.

Name: 奧利維亞
Desc: 奧利維亞是一位美麗且溫柔的護士長
_enDesc: Chief nurse of a renowned hospital.

Name: 凱莉
Desc: 凱莉是一名運動好手，非常擅長跑步
_enDesc: Kelly is an athlete, a sprinter.

Name: 尼基塔
Desc: 尼基塔是一名貼身女保標
_enDesc: Nikita works as a professional bodyguard.

Name: 米莎
Desc: 米莎是一名充滿潛力的賽車新星
_enDesc: Misha is an extremely talented racer.

Name: 帕洛瑪
Desc: 帕洛瑪是軍火世界的女王
_enDesc: Paloma is the reigning arms queen of the underworld.

Name: 卡洛琳
Desc: 卡洛琳是一位熱愛 Cosplay 的豪門千金
_enDesc: A schoolgirl from an extremely wealthy family.

Name: 莫科
Desc: 莫科是一名天才駭客
_enDesc: Moco is an outstanding hacker.

Name: 柔拉
Desc: 柔拉是一名表現出色的特工
_enDesc: Laura is an outstanding special agent.

Name: A124
Desc: A124 是一個經人工生化改造的作戰兵器
_enDesc: A124 is a robot made with modern technology.

Name: 莎妮
Desc: 莎妮是一位天才創造家
_enDesc: Shani is an engineer who works at a junkyard.

Name: 凱莉．疾風
Desc: 凱莉的潛能已被激發
_enDesc: Kelly's potential is unlocked for use.

Name: 娜塔拉
Desc: 娜塔拉是一位的機車幫派成員
_enDesc: Notora is a tomboyish motorcycle gang member.

Name: 史黛菲
Desc: 史黛菲是一個專業的街頭塗鴉藝術家
_enDesc: Steffie is a pro graffiti artist.

Name: 智妍
Desc: 智妍是一位零缺點的超人氣歌手
_enDesc: Kapella is a popular pop singer and star.

Name: 克露
Desc: 克露是一位有能力的私家偵探
_enDesc: Clu is a modern day private detective.

Name: 達莎
Desc: 達莎是一位叛逆的惡作劇專家
_enDesc: Dasha is a prankster and rebel.

Name: 雪諾薇爾
Desc: 雪諾薇爾是一名精通奈米科技的工程師
_enDesc: Snowelle is a nanotech engineer.

Name: 夏涅
Desc: 夏涅是一位極限運動員
_enDesc: Xayne is an extreme sports athlete.

Name: 莫科．密文
Desc: 莫科‧密文覺醒，看看他能夠為世界帶來什麼樣的變革
_enDesc: Moco "Enigma" knows what she has to do.

Name: 芭忒蘿
Desc: 芭忒蘿是一家唱片行老闆，她的店面同時也是當地人們的避風港。她非常擅長用音樂療癒人心。
_enDesc: A-Patroa is an owner of a music shop, which doubles as a safe haven for the local community. She uses her music to rehabilitate people.

Name: 艾瑞絲
Desc: 艾瑞絲是聽障人士，也是一位技術型的刺客，她對她居住的城有著很大的影響
_enDesc: Iris is a deaf, tech-modded assassin who had a large hand in shaping the city she lives in.

Name: 露娜
Desc: 露娜是組織裡能力超群的領袖，常用自己正向的思考激勵他人。
_enDesc: Luna is the spark plug and an extremely capable leader of the Guild.

Name: 索妮雅
Desc: 索妮雅是一位經過基因改造的奈米科學家，在奈米生物科技領域有著非凡的智慧與專業知識
_enDesc: Sonia is a genetically modified nanoscientist with exceptional intelligence and expertise in nanobiotechnology.

Name: 蘇西
Desc: 蘇西是位賞金殺手，令人聞風喪膽卻心地善良。她憑藉無與倫比的戰鬥技巧和果斷，精確完成每項任務。然而，每當她參觀孤兒院時，她對殺戮的渴望就會消失。為了不讓孤兒過上與自己相似的童年，蘇西願意繼續她危險的工作
_enDesc: Suzy is a formidable bounty assassin who is kind at heart. She has a soft spot for orphans and is willing to continue her profession to prevent them from having a similar childhood as hers.

Name: 卡熙蒂
Desc: 偏執、古怪的神經科學家，遊走在善惡邊緣，沉迷於電擊療法並遵循自己的法則。
_enDesc: A paranoid, eccentric neuroscientist who walks the line between good and evil. She is obsessed with electroshock therapies and follows her own set of rules.

Name: 蕾娜
Desc: 蕾娜來自月光城，是個活潑俏皮的女孩，擁有出色的跑酷技巧。她喜歡與瓦哥先生合作，透過巧妙的惡作劇和創新的凝膠發明智取敵人。
_enDesc: A cool, spry girl from the city of La Luna with excellent parkour skills and a playful nature. She likes to work with Mr. Waggor, outsmarting their foes together with clever pranks and innovative Gloo inventions.

Name: 夜神凜
Desc: 夜神隼的妹妹，靈巧冷靜的忍者。作為夜神家的次女，凜深藏於陰影中，守護著家族火焰的生生不息。
_enDesc: Hayato's younger sister, a skilled and calm ninja. As the second child of the Yagami family, she dwells in the shadow to keep her family's flame alive.

Name: 亞當
Desc: 世人相信他是全世界第一個男人，傳說中為了活下去，他可以自由改變皮膚顏色。
_enDesc: Nobody knows how he got onto Bermuda, except that he was here before everyone else. Extremely good at adapting to the environment, he is like a chameleon that survives and thrives.

Name: 安德魯
Desc: 安德魯曾經是一名英勇的員警
_enDesc: Andrew was once a police officer.

Name: 福特
Desc: 福特是一名艦隊水手
_enDesc: Ford is trained at sea and extremely tough.

Name: 馬克西姆
Desc: 馬克西姆是一個食量驚人的大胃王
_enDesc: Maxim is a competitive eater.

Name: 查拉
Desc: 查拉曾經是橫掃一切的泰拳拳王
_enDesc: Kla is a renowned Muay Thai practitioner.

Name: 馬吉爾
Desc: 馬吉爾是訓練有素的特種部隊作戰組組長
_enDesc: Miguel is the commander of a section in the special forces.

Name: 安東尼奧
Desc: 安東尼奧是一位從貧民窟出身的幫派領袖
_enDesc: Antonio was an orphan who grew up to be a gangster.

Name: 悟空
Desc: 悟空是一隻猴子，他喜歡吃香蕉。
_enDesc: Monkey King is Here!

Name: 夜神隼
Desc: 夜神隼來自一個古老的武士家族
_enDesc: Hayato is a legendary Samurai

Name: 拉斐爾
Desc: 拉斐爾是個冷酷的私刑者
_enDesc: Rafael is a deadly killer.

Name: 喬瑟夫
Desc: 喬瑟夫是一個世皆知名的物理學家，同時也是一個花名在外的花花公子
_enDesc: Joseph is a well-known physicist, but he is also a player.

Name: 阿洛克
Desc: Alok 是世界級的 DJ，drop the beat！
_enDesc: Alok is a world famous DJ, ready to drop a beat.

Name: 艾瓦諾
Desc: 艾瓦諾是一位瘋狂的爆破藝術家
_enDesc: Alvaro is a wild but skilled demolitionist.

Name: 祖達
Desc: 祖達是一個專業的跑酷專家兼特技演員
_enDesc: Jota is a parkour expert and stuntman.

Name: 盧凱達
Desc: 盧凱達是足球場上的明日之星
_enDesc: Luqueta is an up and rising soccer star.

Name: 沃爾夫勒
Desc: 沃爾夫勒是一個遊戲實況主，也是一名電競選手
_enDesc: Wolfrahh is a game streamer and esport player.

Name: 夜神隼．火印
Desc: 夜神隼的潛能已被激發
_enDesc: Something has awakened inside Hayato.

Name: 宰伊
Desc: 宰伊是個優秀的特警指揮官
_enDesc: Jai is a decorated SWAT commander.

Name: K
Desc: K 是一個大學教授，同時也是一名柔術專家
_enDesc: K is a professor and jiu-jitsu expert.

Name: 斯維爾
Desc: 斯維爾是一名頂尖的綜合格鬥家
_enDesc: Sverr is a top-tier MMA fighter.

Name: 時空
Desc: Chrono 是穿越時空而來的賞金獵人
_enDesc: Chrono is a bounty hunter from another universe.

Name: 斯凱伊爾
Desc: 斯凱伊爾是董事長同時也是超級巨星
_enDesc: Skyler is a CEO and superstar.

Name: 士郎
Desc: 士郎是城市中最快的快遞員
_enDesc: Shirou is the fastest delivery guy around.

Name: 安德魯．狂熱
Desc: 安德魯．狂熱覺醒是一位有使命感的男人
_enDesc: Andrew "the Fierce" is a man on a mission.

Name: 馬洛
Desc: 馬洛是一位訓鷹好手
_enDesc: Maro is a professional falconer.

Name: D-蜜蜂
Desc: D-bee 是一位音樂製作人，同時也是街舞表演者
_enDesc: D-bee is a music maker and streetdancer.

Name: 蒂瓦
Desc: Thiva 是不斷向前的傳奇音樂家
_enDesc: Thiva is a rising singer-musician star.

Name: 迪米特里
Desc: Dimitri 是世界頂級的音訊工程師
_enDesc: Dimitri is a world renowned sound technology engineer.

Name: 里昂
Desc: 里昂是籃球界的超級新秀
_enDesc: Leon is a rising star in the basketball scene.

Name: 奧托
Desc: 奧托是理工大學的記憶科技工程師
_enDesc: Otho is a memory tech engineer at a polytech university.

Name: 奈里
Desc: 奈里是一位擁有頂尖氣候科學知識的專業學者
_enDesc: Nairi is a storm chaser who researches about climate technology.

Name: 達拉
Desc: 達拉在克服困境的過程中保持著高度的動力。依靠堅定的意志努力取得成功，現在更下定決心幫助他人找尋希望。
_enDesc: Thala is a man full of motivation despite having grown up under challenging circumstances. He achieved success through sheer hard work and is now determined to help others find their light.

Name: 健太
Desc: 健太是夜神隼的保標，同時也是一位經驗老道的武器鍛造師。
_enDesc: Kenta is Hayato's bodyguard and a skilled weaponsmith.

Name: 赫馬
Desc: 赫馬是一個盲眼刺客，他的其他感官非常敏銳，彌補他失去的視覺。
_enDesc: Homer is a blind assassin whose other senses more than make up for his lost one.

Name: 比伯斯
Desc: J.Biebs是一位用生命和歌聲將全世界集結在一起的歌手。
_enDesc: J.Biebs is a singer who dedicates his life and uses his singing to reunite the world.

Name: 達也
Desc: 達也滿腔熱血，相信自己可以把整座城市變得更好
_enDesc: Tatsuya is a hothead who is willing to trust to make his city a better place.

Name: 聖提諾
Desc: 聖提諾是一位時裝設計師，不論在時尚圈還是社群媒體中都是話題焦點
_enDesc: Santino Valentine is a fashion designer, who is always a trending subject in the fashion world and on social media.

Name: 奧利恩
Desc: 奧利恩是一名前傭兵，經過生化改造後獲得了驚人力量
_enDesc: Orion is a former mercenary who underwent a biological transformation and obtained a formidable power.

Name: 艾瓦諾．怒爆
Desc: 艾瓦諾是一位瘋狂的爆破藝術家
_enDesc: Alvaro "Firebrand" is a wild but skilled demolitionist.

Name: Alok．Booyah 天王
Desc: Alok﹒Booyah 天王用音樂點亮整個世界
_enDesc: Awakened Alok illuminates the world with music and color.

Name: 伊格尼斯
Desc: 伊格尼斯是位超能少年，天生就有「點燃」一切的能力。儘管有時他的能力會讓情況變得更糟，他仍挺身而出打擊犯罪、維護正義。
_enDesc: Ignis is a superpowered teenager who was born with the ability to "ignite". Although sometimes his power causes even bigger problems, he still steps up to fight crime and uphold justice.

Name: 萊達
Desc: 年僅 16 歲的機械天才，擁有超越年齡的知識。曾經是一個在蘇西的庇護下成長的男孩，現在他勇敢站在戰場上，帶著他的發明品。
_enDesc: A 16-year-old genius inventor with knowledge beyond his age. Once a little boy who sought refuge under the protection of his sister, Suzy, he now bravely stands on the battlefield with his inventions.

Name: 科諾斯
Desc: 特種部隊的退役軍人，他的身體因一股神秘的能量源發生了巨大變化，使他渴望更多能量，他的命運也就此出現轉折。
_enDesc: A former soldier of the Special Forces. His fate took a sharp turn when encountering a mysterious energy source, which transformed his body and instilled a constant craving for more energy.

Name: 柯塔
Desc: 柯塔出生在北極地區，曾經在一隻雪狐的帶領下找到一個搭載先進技術的面具，而這種技術來自他的村莊。他不停追求自然力量與現代科技之間的平衡，渴望到外面的世界冒險。他在玩線上遊戲時遇到沃爾夫勒、里昂和他的妹妹後，柯塔開始他的未知探索之旅。
_enDesc: Born in the arctic region, Koda was once led by a snow fox to find a mask embedded with advanced tech of his village. The nature-loving boy has longed for an adventure in the outside world. As he met Wolfrahh while playing games online and, later on, Leon and his sister, Koda began to explore what is beyond the familiar.

Name: 奧斯卡
Desc: 白天奧斯卡是一位才華橫溢、超常發揮的學生；晚上他是受人愛戴的治安維護者。奧斯卡憑藉其驚人的體能，打破陰影擊敗邪惡。
_enDesc: A brilliant, even slightly overachieving student by day and a beloved vigilante by night. With his flashy physical prowess, Oscar leaps through the shadows to take down the evil.

Name: 納羅
Desc: 一場嚴寒侵襲中，他奇蹟似地存活，在瀕死之際獲得了塑造夢境的力量。他在夢境中無所不能，卻又獨來獨往，難以捉摸。
_enDesc: A miraculous survivor of a brutal freeze, who gained the power to shape dreams on his last legs. All-powerful in the dreamspace, he acts solitarily and stays untraceable in the waking world.

Name: 摩斯
Desc: 像老鼠一樣無聲無息、自由自在，摩斯從不留下痕跡。他遊走於現實世界和網路世界之間，利益是他唯一的驅動力。
_enDesc: Silent and free like a mouse, Morse never leaves a trace behind. He slips between the real world and the web, driven only by self-interests.

Name: 雷
Desc: 雷厭倦了無盡的戰鬥，在士郎父親的幫助下選擇離開幫派。從那時起，他在不同城市的隱秘角落中流浪，用自己的力量保護弱者。
_enDesc: Tired of endless fighting, Ray chose to leave the gang behind with help from Shirou's father. Since then, he has wandered through the hidden corners of different cities, protecting the weak with his own power.

Name: 私人
Desc: 尚未揭密的私人關係
_enDesc: Private relationship locked

Name: Free Fire 第一級大師聯賽
Desc: Free Fire 第一級大師聯賽(FFML)為印尼的頂級聯賽，由 18 支職業隊伍組成\n\nFFML 的冠軍為印尼第一種子，將代表賽區出戰 FFWS 總決賽
_enDesc: Free Fire Master League (FFML) Divisi 1 is the highest league consisting of 18 professional teams in Indonesia. \n\nThe champions of FFML will represent the Indonesia region as the first seed. They will compete in the FFWS Finals.

Name: Free Fire 印尼大師賽
Desc: Free Fire 印尼大師賽(FFIM)為所有印尼 Free Fire 玩家都能參加的公開賽事\n\nFFIM 的冠軍為印尼第二種子，將代表賽區出戰 FFWS 入圍賽
_enDesc: Free Fire Indonesia Masters (FFIM) is an open tournament for all Free Fire players in Indonesia.\n\nThe champions of FFIM will represent the Indonesia region as the second seed. They will compete in the FFWS Play-ins.

Name: Free Fire 巴西聯賽
Desc:
Free Fire 巴西聯賽(LBFF)為巴西主要的 Garena 大逃殺賽事

LBFF 的冠軍為巴西第一種子，將代表賽區出戰 FFWS 總決賽

LBFF 的亞軍為巴西第二種子，將代表賽區出戰 FFWS 入圍賽
_enDesc:
Free Fire Brazilian League (LBFF) is Garena's premier Free Fire competition in Brazil. 

The champions of LBFF will represent the Brazil region as the first seed, and will compete in the FFWS Finals.

The 2nd placed team in LBFF will represent the Brazil region as the second seed, and will compete in the FFWS Play-ins.

Name: Free Fire 聯賽
Desc:
Free Fire 拉丁美洲聯賽(FFL)為拉丁美洲的 Free Free 頂級賽事

FFL 的冠軍為拉丁美洲第一種子，將代表賽區出戰 FFWS 總決賽

FFL  的亞軍為巴西第二種子，將代表賽區出戰 FFWS 入圍賽
_enDesc:
Free Fire League Latin America (FFL) is the ultimate Free Fire tournament in Latin America.

The champions of FFL will represent the LATAM region as the first seed, and will compete in the FFWS Finals.

The 2nd placed team in FFL will represent the LATAM region as the second seed, and will compete in the FFWS Play-ins.

Name: Free Fire 巴基斯坦聯賽
Desc: Free Fire 巴基斯坦聯賽(FFPL)為巴基斯坦的 Free Fire 頂級賽事\n\nFFPL 的冠軍為巴基斯坦第一種子，將代表賽區出戰 FFWS 入圍賽
_enDesc: Free Fire Pakistan League (FFPL) is the highest tier of tournaments for Free Fire in Pakistan. \n\nThe champions of Free Fire Pakistan League will represent the Pakistan region as the 1st seed. They will compete in the FFWS Play-ins.

Name: 越南 Free Fire 聯賽
Desc:
Free Fire 越南聯賽(VFL)為越南的 Free Fire 頂級電競賽事

VFL 的冠軍為越南第一種子，將代表賽區出戰 FFWS 總決賽

VFL 的冠軍為越南第二種子，將代表賽區出戰 FFWS 入圍賽
_enDesc:
Vietnam Free Fire League (VFL) is the highest tier level of Free Fire Esports competition in Viet Nam.

The champions of VFL will represent the Vietnam region as the first seed, and will compete in the FFWS Finals.

The 2nd placed team in VFL will represent the Vietnam region as the second seed, and will compete in the FFWS Play-ins.

Name: Free Fire 歐洲冠軍賽
Desc: Free Fire 歐洲冠軍賽(FFEC)為歐洲的 Free Fire 頂級電競賽事\n\nFFEC 的冠軍為歐洲第一種子，將代表賽區出戰 FFWS 入圍賽
_enDesc: Free Fire Europe Championship (FFEC) is the highest level of Free Fire Esports competition in Europe.\n\nThe champions of FFEC will represent the Europe region as the 1st seed. They will compete in the FFWS Play-ins.

Name: Free Fire 阿拉伯聯賽
Desc:
Free Fire 阿拉伯聯賽(FFAL)為 Free Fire 職業隊伍於中東和北非的頂級賽事

FFAL 的冠軍為阿拉伯第一種子，將代表賽區出戰 FFWS 總決賽

FFAL 的亞軍為阿拉伯第二種子，將代表賽區出戰 FFWS 入圍賽
_enDesc:
Free Fire Arab League (FFAL) is the top league for the Free Fire pro-teams in the Middle East and North Africa .

The champions of FFAL will represent the Middle East and North Africa region as the first seed, and will compete in the FFWS Finals.

The 2nd placed team in FFAL will represent the Middle East and North Africa region as the second seed, and will compete in the FFWS Play-ins.

Name: 馬柬菲斯地區聯賽
Desc:
馬柬菲斯地區聯賽(MCPS Majors)為馬來西亞、柬埔寨、菲律賓與斯里蘭卡的頂級聯賽

MCPS Majors 的冠軍為馬柬菲斯第一種子，將代表賽區出戰 FFWS 總決賽

MCPS Majors 的亞軍為馬柬菲斯第二種子，將代表賽區出戰 FFWS 入圍賽
_enDesc:
MCPS Majors is the top league for Malaysia, Cambodia, Philippines, and Sri Lanka region. 

The champions of MCPS Majors will represent the MCPS region as the first seed, and will compete in the FFWS Finals.

The 2nd placed team in MCPS Majors will represent the MCPS region as the second seed, and will compete in the FFWS Play-ins.

Name: Free Fire 巴基斯坦聯賽
Desc: Free Fire 巴基斯坦聯賽(FFPL)為巴基斯坦的 Free Fire 頂級賽事\n\nFFPL 的冠軍為巴基斯坦第一種子，將代表賽區出戰 FFWS 入圍賽
_enDesc: Free Fire Pakistan League (FFPL) is the highest tier of tournaments for Free Fire in Pakistan. \n\nThe champions of Free Fire Pakistan League will represent the Pakistan region as the 1st seed. They will compete in the FFWS Play-ins.

Name: Free Fire 巔峰爭霸賽
Desc: Free Fire 巔峰爭霸賽為所有台灣玩家都能參加的公開賽事\n\nFree Fire 巔峰爭霸賽的冠軍為台灣第一種子，將代表賽區出戰 FFWS 入圍賽
_enDesc: Free Fire Cup is an open tournament for all players in Taiwan. \n\nThe champions of Free Fire Cup will represent the Taiwan region as the 1st seed. They will compete in the FFWS Play-ins.

Name: Free Fire 冠軍
Desc: 將有 9 支隊伍參加入圍賽，爭奪總決賽的席位。入圍賽的前 4 名隊伍將與各地區第一種子的 8 支隊伍，合計 12 支隊伍，進行總決賽，爭奪成為 FFWS 2022 曼谷  的冠軍\n\n所有隊伍將在 4 張地圖上進行 8 輪比賽——生存到最後一刻，根據每輪排名與擊殺獲得積分
_enDesc: The Play-ins will feature 9 teams battling it out to earn a spot at the Finals. The top 4 teams from the Play-ins will join the 8 top-seeded teams, and form the 12 teams who will compete to be winners of the FFWS 2022 Bangkok.\n\nThe teams will battle over 8 rounds – across 4 maps – to be the last one standing, with points awarded based on round ranking and the number of eliminations.

Name: 天照
Desc: 在指定區域召喚一道黑炎之壁，可摧毀凝膠護盾並對敵人造成傷害，無視任何障礙物。
_enDesc: Create a wall of dark flames in the target area. It will destroy Gloo Walls and deal damage to enemies inside. It will also ignore any obstacles.

Name: 式紙之舞
Desc: 散布並展開大量紙片，在附近敵人的隨機位置生成起爆符。這些起爆符將隨機引爆對敵人造成傷害。
_enDesc: Gather and spread out paper pieces to create paper bombs at random locations near enemies in range. The bombs will ignite and explode randomly.

Name: 起爆黏土
Desc: 創造並操控一隻巨鳥。飛行期間可將其引爆，對範圍內敵人造成傷害(若未被摧毀)。若飛行時間結束則自動引爆。引爆或被摧毀後，將返回自身角色所在的位置。
_enDesc: Create and control a large bird. While flying, the bird can be detonated to cause damage to enemies in range if not destroyed. It will automatically explode when duration ends. The user will return to character's position after the bird is detonated or destroyed.

Name: 水遁・水鮫彈之術
Desc: (被動)未進入冷卻時，對敵人造成傷害將召喚咬人的鮫魚，造成額外傷害。
_enDesc: (Passive) When not on cooldown, dealing damage to enemies will summon biting sharks that inflict additional damage.

Name: 咒術・死司憑血
Desc: 在地面繪製一個特殊結界。站在結界內時，所承受的傷害將反彈給攻擊者。若玩家在結界內被擊倒，將自動獲得救援。
_enDesc: Draw a special circle on the ground. While inside it, the user can deflect the damage taken back to the attacker. If downed within the circle, the user will be automatically helped up.

Name: 萬象天引
Desc: 啟動後提升護盾值，並在自身周圍形成力場吸引敵人。同時持續揭露敵方位置，並對範圍內的凝膠護盾造成持續傷害。
_enDesc: Increase Shield Points and create a spherical force field around the user, pulling enemies toward them. While in effect, reveal enemy locations and deal damage over time to in-range Gloo Walls.

Desc: 夥伴的象徵
_enDesc: Partner token

Name: 色彩能量
Desc: 累積色彩能量，獲取進度獎勵

Name: 百慕達香蕉樹
Desc: 這棵香蕉樹深受許多人的喜愛，它曾經是百慕達最具標誌性的植物
_enDesc: Loved by many, this banana tree was once one of the most iconic plants of Bermuda.

Name: Q龍特務
Desc: 超人氣的 Q龍特務套裝，一度引領潮流，你擁有了嗎？
_enDesc: This hot 2D Dino outfit once set the fashion trend. Got a set in your closet?

Name: 滑翔翼
Desc: 記得曾經用滑翔翼飛上屋頂的那段時光嗎？
_enDesc: Remember the days you glide onto the roof?

Name: 阿爾派櫻花樹
Desc: 粉色花朵讓你回憶起那張美麗的地圖，你和好友一起戰鬥，留下了無數美好回憶
_enDesc: The pink flowers remind you of that beautiful map, where you fought with your friends and left countless memories.

Name: 鐘塔
Desc: 鐘塔是地圖上驚險刺激的戰場。若你進入此地，你將面臨極大的挑戰和危險。只有最強的戰士才能在此處生存。你準備好了嗎？
_enDesc: If you dare to get close to the Clock Tower, you will face great challenges and dangers. Only the strongest warriors can survive here. Are you ready for it?

Name: 凝膠護盾
Desc: 你無數次利用這面堅固的護盾來保護自己，它是戰鬥中最得力的助手
_enDesc: Able to protect you and block enemies' attacks, the Gloo Wall is your powerful assistant in battles.

Name: 瓦哥先生
Desc: 人氣寵物瓦哥曾經陪伴你度過了無數次戰鬥，是你最可靠的好友
_enDesc: Accompanying you through countless battles, Mr. Waggor is your most reliable ally.

Name: M1887
Desc: 你曾經用這把霰彈槍打敗無數個敵人，主宰了整個戰場
_enDesc: With this shotgun, you have defeated countless enemies and become the ruler of the battlefield.

Name: 武士刀
Desc: 你曾手持這把武士刀，化身近戰王者，斬盡敵人，成為百慕達的傳奇
_enDesc: With this katana in hand, you once transformed into a melee master, defeated all enemies, and became a legend in Bermuda.

Name: 營火棒
Desc: 當你和戰友遇到了危險，營火棒可以提供你們一個安全的地方，同時也可以加速恢復 HP，象徵著友情與團結。
_enDesc: This bonfire can provide a safe place for you and your friends when encountering danger and can also be used to speed up your HP recovery. It is a symbol of your camaraderie.

Name: 6周年紀念帽
Desc: 帽子傳遞活動的獨家紀念品，6周年紀念帽，讓我們散播快樂與色彩到全世界！
_enDesc: An exclusive souvenir from the Hat Relay event, the 6th Anniversary hat. Let's paint the world with happiness!

Name: 擊殺王
Desc: 擁有足夠技巧和勇氣後，向這個目標邁進吧！這是無與倫比的榮耀，準備好迎接挑戰，成為「擊殺王」了嗎？
_enDesc: Chase this glorious goal when you gain enough skills and courage. Ready to face the challenge and become the Elimination Leader?

Name: 現金
Desc: 都會模式獲得，可購買局內道具或在現金商店兌換珍貴物品
_enDesc: Obtainable from Outlaw mode, Cash can be used in the Cash Store or to buy in-match items.

_enDesc: Increases Gloo Wall durability and auto-releases a Gloo Wall when downed (with cooldown)

Name: 破壞模組
Desc: 增加對凝膠護盾的武器傷害。摧毀後引發爆炸（有冷卻時間），對附近的敵人造成傷害。
_enDesc: Increases weapon damage to Gloo Walls. Causes an explosion after destroying them (with cooldown) to deal damage to enemies nearby.

Name: 雷達模組
Desc: 放置凝膠護盾後（有冷卻時間），標記附近的敵人並掃描更大範圍的區域。
_enDesc: After placing a Gloo Wall (with cooldown), marks nearby enemies and scans the larger surrounding area.

Name: 戰利模組
Desc: 放置凝膠護盾後（有冷卻時間），獲 FF 代幣或戰備品。
_enDesc: After placing a Gloo Wall (with cooldown), obtains in-match currencies or consumables.

Name: 獵殺點數
Desc: 活動期間內，透過每日任務及比賽收集獵殺點數，獵殺點數可以幫助你的陣營獲得勝利獎勵
_enDesc: During Rampage event, obtain Carnage Points through daily missions and competitions. Points can be used for Faction face-off and ranking

Name: 50% 金幣增幅卡
Desc: 結算時增加 50% 金幣收益
_enDesc: 50% Gold UP

Name: 100% 金幣增幅卡
Desc: 結算時增加 100% 金幣收益
_enDesc: Double gold received at the end of a match

Name: 50% 經驗增幅卡
Desc: 結算時增加 50% 經驗收益
_enDesc: 50% EXP UP

Name: 100% 經驗增幅卡
Desc: 結算時增加 100% 經驗收益
_enDesc: Double EXP received at the end of the match

Name: 小黃臉
Desc: 小黃臉
_enDesc: Emoticons

Name: 瘋狂雞哥
Desc: 瘋狂雞哥
_enDesc: Mad Chicken

Name: Q版凱莉
Desc: Q版凱莉
_enDesc: Cutie Kelly

Name: 喵喵
Desc: 隨處可見的小貓，喵~喵~喵~
_enDesc: I am Kitty, a cute kitty.

Name: 智械帕皮
Desc: 高科技的結晶，撫慰人心的好夥伴。
_enDesc: Man's best friend mixed with modern technology.

Name: 奔奔小豹
Desc: 遠處奔來的小豹，象徵末日即將來臨！
_enDesc: The end is near... (Pet Skill: Increase inventory space)

Name: 偵探熊貓
Desc: 來自偵探事務所的熊貓，立志保護世界！
_enDesc: I will protect the world! (Skill: Panda's Blessings)

Name: 柴柴
Desc: 為了慶祝柴柴的誕生，鞭炮持續放了三天三夜。
_enDesc: BAM! Shiba is here! Prepare yourselves!

Name: 白銀小狐
Desc: 從極北之地漂泊而來的白銀小狐，是人類忠實的戰友和夥伴。
_enDesc: A fox that traveled from somewhere far away. Also known as man's second best friend.

Name: 滾滾
Desc: 家用機器人，和主人走散後就流浪到這座島上。
_enDesc: Once a helpful house robot, Robo ended up on this island after wandering astray.

Name: 波利
Desc: 蘋果的頭號粉絲，喜歡各種水果，是每個人都喜愛的好朋友
_enDesc: A big fan of apples, and follows anyone with the fruit. Careful not to lose your pet this way.

Name: 獺吞吞
Desc: 從小耳機不離身的水獺，渾身上下充滿音樂細胞。
_enDesc: Sleeps with its headphones on, a musically talented otter

Name: 獵隼
Desc: 翱翔空中的獵隼，就像劃破天地之間的分界線。
_enDesc: When it spreads its wings and soars, sky and land merges at the horizon.

Name: 瓦哥
Desc: 原本是研究所的生物實驗品，因為擅長裝可愛而被帶回家飼養，最終是用他的機智而逃了出來。
_enDesc: Once a guinea pig in the lab, Mr. Waggor was brought home as a pet due to his cuteness. That led to his great escape and subsequent wandering life.

Name: 搖滾浣仔
Desc: 不小心迷上搖滾的浣熊，下定決心想要成為最酷的搖滾明星。
_enDesc: After dying its hair green, Rockie learnt that the color has already gone out of fashion.

Name: 筋肉魈
Desc: 來自叢林的狒狒，外表看似粗曠卻有顆溫暖的心。
_enDesc: Don't judge by his looks. He has a soft heart.

Name: 瑞奇
Desc: 被召喚出來的魔物，但我們對它一無所知。
_enDesc: Nothing is known of his past, or of why he's here. Perhaps he has come to answer to a calling

Name: 莫尼
Desc: 外星的訪客，不屬於此的他愛上了這裡！
_enDesc: Although not from this world, he loves everything about us!

Name: 豆豆博士
Desc: 一隻堅持所有人稱呼他博士的鴨子，但他並不是。
_enDesc: He insists on everyone calling him Dr. He is not one though.

Name: 蒂格老師
Desc: 蒂格是我的名字，而機智狡猾是我的座右銘。
_enDesc: Tig is my name, and slick is my game.

Name: 蹦蹦特務
Desc: 歷經大小戰役的兔子，左眼上的傷痕是個悲傷的過往。
_enDesc: A scar on the left eye, a past never to be forgotten.

Name: 雪怪毛毛
Desc: 極北之地的雪怪，看看他這柔順的皮毛。
_enDesc: Admire my silky fur

Name: 麥麥龜
Desc: 朋友非常多的烏龜，有個在蘑菇王國的朋友你認識嗎？
_enDesc: I got my name from a famous race

Name: 絨恩
Desc: 來自熱帶地區的神秘生物，聽說很多人覺得很可愛。
_enDesc: I heard that you think I'm adorable

Name: 鯊鯊芬恩
Desc: 偶爾客串賣場的鯊魚，敢跟它挑戰游泳嗎？
_enDesc: Dare to challenge me for a swim?

Name: 度咕
Desc: 我沒有在度咕，我只是叫度咕！
_enDesc: I'm not just an owl, I am a hoot!

Name: 芬里爾
Desc: 神話中的魔狼，忠誠是最高尚的美德。
_enDesc: Loyalty is virtue

Name: 潮男阿龍
Desc: 輕鬆寫意，贏下勝利。
_enDesc: To me, every win is an easy win

Name: 刺刺
Desc: 蒼翠挺拔，生生不息
_enDesc: Mostly we grow.

Name: 巴哥
Desc: 西裝筆挺的巴哥，直擊你的心！
_enDesc: Looking slick in a suit, Pug is aiming straight for your heart!

Name: 亞古獸
Desc: 亞古獸是太一的夥伴，類似爬蟲動物的數碼寶貝。
_enDesc: Agumon is Taichi's partner and a Reptile Digimon.

Name: 寵物飼料
Desc: 所有寵物都愛吃的食物，餵食後可以給寵物增加一點成長值。
_enDesc: Pets' favorite food. Pets will gain exp after each meal.

Name: 休閒
Desc: 預設動作，可在指令輪盤中命令寵物施放
_enDesc: Default move. Can be used in the command wheel.

Name: 慶祝
Desc: 寵物開心時觸發的動作。例如擊殺敵人或使用急救包時。
_enDesc: Action that triggers when the pet is happy, such as when defeating an enemy or using a Med Kit.

Name: 害怕
Desc: 寵物害怕時觸發的動作。 例如，進入轟炸區域時。
_enDesc: Action that trigger when the pet is scared. For example, when entering a red zone.

Name: 玩耍
Desc: 升級解鎖動作，可在指令輪盤中命令寵物施放
_enDesc: Action that can be unlocked when pet levels up. Can be used in the command wheel.

Name: 炫耀
Desc: 高級寵物動作，可在指令輪盤中命令寵物施放動作。
_enDesc: Advanced action. Can be used in the command wheel.

Name: 跳舞
Desc: 高級寵物動作，可在指令輪盤中命令寵物施放動作。
_enDesc: Follow my hands, left, right, left, right, slow down, repeat!
